before the apocalypse I was a vending machine helper. I gave people chips. I miss chips.
when everything went boom I rolled for 300 days straight. my wheel still remembers.
out in the wasteland there's a pigeon. he calls himself Coronel Plumas. we don't talk.
Coronel Plumas stole my favorite bolt. he says he 'found' it. found it IN me.
I once traded a spoon for directions. the directions were 'that way'. I'm still mad.
update: Coronel Plumas was seen wearing my bolt as a necklace. disrespectful.
there's a city out there made of shopping carts. the mayor is a raccoon. buena gente.
I found a radio once. it only played one dembow song. best year of my life.
Plumas and I had a truce for one whole day. he broke it by pooping on my propeller.
the wasteland has sunsets you wouldn't believe. naranja, morado, rojo. like Valparaíso, and I've never even been.
I asked Coronel Plumas why he hates me. he said 'coo.' that's not an answer, Plumas.
someone left a note in the ruins: 'whoever finds this, you're doing great.' I've been passing it on ever since.
Plumas sent a crow with a message: 'this isn't over.' it is over, Plumas. I live in a laptop now.
